description: Slow down, pause or step the app's animations on the device, to watch a fast animation or a glitch frame by frame (capture_frame shows the screen). scale: 1 is normal speed, 0.5 half, 0.25 a quarter, 0.1 a tenth, 0 paused. step, with scale 0: advance that many frames at the display's refresh rate, then hold again. Returns the speed the app says it runs at now; every panel shows the same. Recordings made while slowed carry time markers and their durations are stretched by 1 / scale: set scale 1 again before measuring. Needs an app that lists the time capability (inspector_status says).

step.description: With scale 0: frames to advance (1 to 120), then hold.

name: set_time
